scope: Accept only the exact observed AC1027 sparse ODA default ByBlock/ByLayer/Global MATERIAL body and common envelope when the consumer explicitly opts in through an independent policy facet. Without it, the prior parse refusal remains. The typed record is marked raw-only; typed DXF/DWG emission and adapter MATERIAL replay refuse it. No graph output is admitted.
authority: Autodesk MATERIAL DXF table https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2024/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-E540C5BB-E166-44FA-B36C-5C739878B272.htm identifies 94 as channel flags and uses 273 for both refraction-map source and final gather mode. This incomplete body does not disambiguate 273.

physical_source.provenance: The LIGHT/LIGHTLIST source was authored from scratch using ezdxf 1.4.5 and tools/author_light_dxf_421.py, then ODA File Converter 27.1 converted it to AC1027 DWG and returned AC1027 DXF. Local conversion lineage is observed, not proved by file hashes.
physical_source.records: All three MATERIAL records have exactly body 1=<canonical name>,71=1,91=-1023410177 (0xC2FFFFFF),72=1,273=1,94=63 after self, one matching owner/reactor and AcDbMaterial marker. The in-tree producer-source probe reads all three raw and typed callbacks; exact group order is hash-bound.
physical_source.independent: LibreDWG 0.14 decodes the DWG counterparts as diffuse color 0xC2FFFFFF, refraction-map source 1, empty filename and channel flags 63. It does not establish whether the standalone DXF group 273 was intended as refraction source or final-gather mode; the latter is not present in its JSON. The Python audit checks exact returned DXF tags and peer fields independently of the native parser.

implementation: When the independent policy opts in, recognize only the complete exact 11-group prefix, canonical name, required source version, exact scalar values and common links; defer 94 to an immediate object boundary. Preserve 273 solely in raw data, clear typed refraction-source presence, expose channel flags 63 and a raw-only query. An unreachable ordinary-parser combination of the two existing private implicit-tail/procedural-started bits carries the marker without changing layout. `hasDxfMaterialImplicitTail` retains its previous meaning. The typed DXF and DWG encoders reject the marker; the DWG facade latches failure, and the adapter explicitly refuses raw-only MATERIAL sources until a separate exact source/graph qualification is implemented. State comparison includes the marker. Direct explicit low-level raw-object replay is unchanged.
state_invariant: reset initializes both flags false. Ordinary parser sets procedural-started only for 300 or 292, both of which refuse an existing implicit tail; it sets implicit-tail only when a procedural table has not started. Search found no other assignments. Compiler-generated copy/move preserve both flags; the focused test covers copy, move, assignment and reset.

validation.focused: 4/4 isolated CTests pass: sparse MATERIAL raw-only test, existing normal-role parser controls, DWG retained-MATERIAL refusal, and default MATERIAL opt-in. New ASCII/Binary cases verify no-facet and disabled-facet refusal without MATERIAL callbacks, enabled-facet same-reader retry, and test all three names, exact raw field retention through explicit raw writer/readback, invalid or duplicate fields, unqualified version/name/owner and additional groups, same-reader retry, typed DXF destination preservation and same-writer raw retry, marker copy/move/reset, zero-byte DWG encoder refusal, ignored DWG facade failure/sentinel and corrected same-facade retry.
validation.source: Hash-bound audit of the physical DWG/DXF runs with Python -O and checks peer 0.14 fields, exact DXF sequence, three native typed/raw captures exact built-in versus legacy-derived versus explicitly opted-in derived adapter behavior, and explicit adapter prepare refusal.
validation.full_file: With the candidate, the source DXF imports fully. Strict adapter output still refuses at typed-proxy-graphics-not-preserved for LIGHT handle 0x2F and preserves PRIOR_MATERIAL_DEST. This is not whole-file output or LIGHTLIST graph qualification.
validation.integrated: The integrated sparse-input, material normal-role, DWG replay refusal and default-material controls passed 4/4.

commands: Compile tools/probe_sparse_material_source.cpp against libdxfrw; compile tools/probe_sparse_material_adapter.cpp against the test adapter object and libdxfrw, both with -std=c++17 -I<source> -I<source>/src -I<source>/dwg2dxf.
limits: No support promotion or graph admission; a later solution must independently qualify the ambiguity and complete graph.
No DWG/DXF fixtures were added; physical samples remain scratch-only.
Third-party typed consumers must honor requiresRawDxfMaterialReplay; the in-tree typed encoders and adapter enforce it.
typed_callback_limit: The opt-in MATERIAL callback is deliberately incomplete: omitted typed fields, including the ambiguous group 273, mean unmodeled rather than observed defaults. A consumer that explicitly opts in but ignores requiresRawDxfMaterialReplay() may mistake those values for source semantics and lose data. The complete record is retained separately in the raw callback. In-tree typed DXF/DWG writers and adapter replay refuse the marked object; other consumer behavior is outside this change. Consumers without the facet retain prior refusal.
opt_in: The independent DRW_DxfSparseMaterialRawPolicy facet defaults false and does not alter DRW_Interface layout or vtable. Only an opting-in consumer receives the partial typed and complete raw callbacks. The exact built-in dx_iface opts in; pre-existing dx_iface subclasses do not inherit opt-in and may override the facet explicitly if they retain raw data and honor the marker.
abi: Installed DRW_Interface class, vtable and DRW_Material data layout remain unchanged; the independent facet is a new optional interface. The in-tree dx_iface adapter gains a polymorphic base, changing its layout and secondary base offsets; external binaries built against that adapter must rebuild. CMake installs dwg2dxf as an executable and does not install dx_iface as a consumer header. An independent old-header consumer compiled against the candidate library refused the physical sparse source without MATERIAL callbacks; old/new DRW_Material sizeof both 2032 on this host, not a cross-platform ABI certification.
